p2_definition: All LOW findings in the 2026-09-30 A01-A20 master audit inventory.

tracks.P2-01: Release fingerprint scope, reviewer reproducibility, provenance labeling and architecture/front-door documentation
tracks.P2-05: Delayed economics activation and issuance/halving semantics
tracks.P2-06: Consensus forensics privacy and operator authorization
tracks.P2-07: Explicit signature-profile coverage and helper-certificate domain separation
tracks.P2-08: Shutdown, durable queue and transaction-status concurrency linearization

findings.summary: V2 source_tree_digest is a partial protocol-source digest, not a full release-tree behavior digest
findings.evidence: Runtime release evidence now records exact git_head and git_tree, while docs/V2_SPEC_COMPILER.md explicitly distinguishes the whole tracked release-tree identity from the narrower V2 semantic source_tree_digest. tests/test_p2_a01_release_tree_identity.py proves a tracked build-only mutation changes Git tree identity and the runtime manifest binds the exact current tree.

findings.summary: Exact reviewer procedure is Git-history-dependent and not reproducible from a plain HEAD source archive
findings.evidence: The merged P1 reviewer-reproducibility work already distinguishes full-history verification from historyless source archives, fails explicitly when required historical Git objects are unavailable, and provides the exact restoration/verification path. The P2 baseline inherited that proven closure.

findings.summary: All-canon coverage gates do not prove an executable lifecycle for every canonical type
findings.evidence: A generated tx_lifecycle_assurance_v1_5.json now contains exactly 236 unique canonical lifecycle rows with 236 successful admissions, 236 successful applies, 236 failure-stage vectors, 236 exact success-receipt expectations, 236 duplicate/replay expectations, and persistence/restart requirements for every state-writing row. tests/test_p2_a02_lifecycle_manifest.py rebuilds the manifest exactly, verifies signatures/tx IDs/receipts, reopens every state-writing vector through SQLite with identical state root, and proves an intentionally broken registered handler fails the matrix. Backend and focused revalidation both run gen_tx_lifecycle_assurance_v1_5.py --check.

findings.summary: Determinism validation remains incomplete across machines and protocol breadth
findings.evidence: Repository-side closure preparation is now comprehensive but the original external-evidence requirement remains authoritative. scripts/capture_a04_external_determinism_packet_v1_5.py captures exact commit/tree, narrow per-block replay, DB-backed and fresh-node replay/state-sync, the all-236 lifecycle corpus, scheduler/order permutations, helper serial equivalence, failed-receipt replay, and seeded determinism regressions. scripts/a04_cross_machine_determinism_probe_v1_5.py additionally proves all-236 lifecycle regeneration under PYTHONHASHSEED=0,1,7,42 plus insertion-order-invariant canonical projection. scripts/build_external_cross_machine_replay_transcript_v1_5.py rejects cross-machine mismatches, and strict transcript validation independently checks per-machine digest equality. Closure still requires two real external/physical-machine packets for the same exact commit plus attestation, aggregate transcript, and review; hosted CI is not a substitute.

findings.summary: Existing production BFT rehearsal does not exercise production BFT consensus validity
findings.evidence: The production-composition suite exercises WEALL_MODE=prod, QC-less blocks disabled, signature verification enabled, real follower proposal handling/voting, chained QC progression, restart, wrong-parent rejection, and finality; P2 additionally exercises proposal ingress through NetMeshLoop. These tests passed on the P2 branch in the full backend suite.

findings.summary: Halving clock advances while issuance is locked, creating an unresolved delayed-activation monetary-policy interpretation
findings.evidence: Protocol authority selected GENESIS_RELATIVE for the v1.5 issuance epoch origin. The selected rule preserves the existing absolute-height implementation: 30-block issuance epochs and the 105,120-epoch halving clock advance from Genesis regardless of whether economics is enabled; locked epochs emit nothing and are never backfilled. docs/decisions/A11_F003_ISSUANCE_EPOCH_ORIGIN.md and docs/REAL_TOKENOMICS_IMPLEMENTATION.md now state this normatively. tests/test_p2_a11_genesis_relative_issuance.py covers pre-halving, exact-halving and post-halving activation, locked skipped epochs, deterministic two-node replay, restart/state-sync equivalence, and cap behavior. Promotion to patched_and_proven awaits exact-head backend and reviewer-readiness CI.

findings.summary: Consensus forensics exposes operator/BFT internals anonymously in production
findings.evidence: Production anonymous consensus-forensics now returns only a public consensus-health projection. Wrong presented credentials fail closed and an explicitly configured operator token unlocks bounded forensic detail. tests/test_p2_a12_consensus_forensics_auth.py covers anonymous, wrong-token, and authorized-operator behavior and passes in the P2 backend suite.

findings.summary: Explicit signature profile required is not consistently enforced outside transaction signing
findings.evidence: Received peer identities and helper receipts no longer gain authority through verifier-side signature-profile defaults; missing and unsupported profiles fail closed. tests/test_p2_a13_signature_authority.py covers profile stripping/substitution and passes in the P2 backend suite.

findings.summary: Mainline helper-certificate signatures omit the explicit certificate domain used by the newer hardening path
findings.evidence: Mainline helper certificates bind the explicit certificate domain and signature profile into the signed object; receive-side verification rejects domain/profile stripping, substitution, and cross-object receipt-signature reuse. Adversarial P2 signature-authority tests pass.

findings.summary: Timed block-loop shutdown can hand ownership to a new generation while the old worker is still alive
findings.evidence: BlockProducerLoop lifecycle ownership is serialized; a timed-out stop retains ownership until the worker exits, replacement generation start is refused while the prior worker lives, and finalizer cleanup is generation-sensitive. tests/test_p2_a14_concurrency_closure.py deterministically exercises the stop-timeout/restart/lock-contention interleaving.

findings.summary: The WebRTC durable signal queue can lose updates because its lock is not a single inter-process RMW lock
findings.evidence: The WebRTC durable signal queue now uses one path-scoped POSIX inter-process flock around the entire read/modify/write transaction plus durable atomic replacement. tests/test_p2_a14_concurrency_closure.py drives two OS processes through the same queue and proves no lost rows.

findings.summary: Transaction status can transiently report unknown while a transaction atomically moves from mempool to confirmed index
findings.evidence: Transaction status now resolves tx_index and mempool state from one explicit SQLite read snapshot. The P2 concurrency test forces a commit between the logical lifecycle lookups and proves the response remains pending/confirmed rather than synthesizing unknown.

findings.summary: Primary fresh checkout verification instructions assume an already-created virtual environment
findings.evidence: The primary root/backend fresh-checkout reviewer paths now create a venv, activate it, install hash-locked development dependencies, and install the package before verification. tests/test_p2_a17_fresh_checkout_docs.py enforces the bootstrap ordering.

findings.summary: Frontend repositorySnapshot is a historical V2 specification snapshot, not the current implementation commit
findings.evidence: Frontend provenance no longer labels the historical V2 specification snapshot as repositorySnapshot; the generated field is v2SpecificationSnapshot and tests/test_p2_a18_v2_provenance_label.py enforces the unambiguous name. Generated protocolStatus.ts is regenerated by the reviewer-artifact workflow.

findings.summary: Current whole-system architecture and source-authority map is not obvious from the repository front door
findings.evidence: Weall-Protocol/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md now maps the current runtime/control plane, authority hierarchy, transaction lifecycle, consensus/persistence/PoH/governance/helper/P2P/frontend boundaries, current-vs-target hierarchy, disabled surfaces, and legacy/shadow material; the repository front door links to it and a P2 regression enforces the sections.

findings.summary: Documented production static deployment does not mechanically deliver the repository CSP posture
findings.evidence: The repository ships web/deploy/nginx.conf.template as the tested production Nginx path. Web CI run 37683086740 / job 113003857844 built the production Vite bundle, copied it to an Nginx-readable deployment directory, validated and started the shipped config, asserted the actual HTTP Content-Security-Policy contains script-src 'self' and object-src 'none' without unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval script execution, verified /v1/readyz through the same-origin production proxy, and passed a Chromium browser smoke that rendered the app, loaded same-origin JS assets, exercised the proxied API, and loaded permitted data-image content. The Nginx test and browser smoke both completed success.
